table.name: ref_characteristic_types
table.summary: A reference table defining standard types of characteristics used to describe items, likely in a manufacturing or quality control context.

characteristic_type_code.name: characteristic_type_code
characteristic_type_code.meaning: A unique, short identifier for a specific type of characteristic.

characteristic_type_description.name: characteristic_type_description
characteristic_type_description.meaning: A human-readable text description explaining the characteristic type.

table.name: characteristics
table.summary: A lookup table defining standardized product or item characteristics, such as quality grades, purity levels, and speed ratings.

characteristic_id.name: characteristic_id
characteristic_id.meaning: Unique identifier for each characteristic record.

characteristic_type_code.name: characteristic_type_code
characteristic_type_code.meaning: Categorical code representing the nature of the characteristic (e.g., Grade, Purity).

characteristic_data_type.name: characteristic_data_type
characteristic_data_type.meaning: Data classification or format associated with the characteristic (values appear to be placeholder or legacy data).

characteristic_name.name: characteristic_name
characteristic_name.meaning: Human-readable name or label for the characteristic (e.g., slow, fast, warm).

other_characteristic_details.name: other_characteristic_details
other_characteristic_details.meaning: Additional descriptive text or notes about the characteristic, currently empty in samples.

table.name: ref_colors
table.summary: A reference table mapping short color codes to their descriptive names.

color_code.name: color_code
color_code.meaning: A unique short identifier representing a specific color.

color_description.name: color_description
color_description.meaning: The human-readable name of the color.

table.name: ref_product_categories
table.summary: A reference table defining standard product categories, their descriptions, and associated units of measure.

product_category_code.name: product_category_code
product_category_code.meaning: A unique identifier or short code representing a specific product category.

product_category_description.name: product_category_description
product_category_description.meaning: A textual description providing details about the product category.

unit_of_measure.name: unit_of_measure
unit_of_measure.meaning: The standard unit used to quantify items within this product category.

table.name: product_characteristics
table.summary: Stores the specific characteristic values (e.g., quality level, size) associated with various products.

product_id.name: product_id
product_id.meaning: Unique identifier for the product to which the characteristic applies.

characteristic_id.name: characteristic_id
characteristic_id.meaning: Unique identifier for the specific characteristic being recorded.

product_characteristic_value.name: product_characteristic_value
product_characteristic_value.meaning: The specific value or attribute level assigned to the product for the given characteristic.
